# Introduction to macroeconomics

Teaching material for a starter on macroeconomics, given at the [Ecole Normale Supérieure de Lyon](https://www.ens-lyon.fr/en/).
:::

## Resources

Main reference: [**Advanced Macroeconomics: An Easy Guide**](https://press.lse.ac.uk/site/books/m/10.31389/lsepress.ame/) by Campante et al.

Other good books:

- [**Macroeconomics** (for PhDs)](https://phdmacrobook.org/downloads/) by Azzimonti et al.
- [**Economic growth**](http://piketty.pse.ens.fr/files/BarroSalaIMartin2004.pdf) by Barro and Sala-ì-Martin
- [**Advanced Macroeconomics** (editor website)](https://www.mheducation.com/highered/product/advanced-macroeconomics-romer/M9781260185218.html) by Romer

::: disclaimer
The data and code are meant for pedagogical use only.
:::
